name: Photobook Studio
tagline: A whole photobook, drafted for you
pitch: Point it at a folder of photos and it drafts the whole book, then exports PDFs a printer will take as they are.
problem: Photobook sites want every photo uploaded, then placed by hand.

stats.label: book templates that restyle the whole book
Lulu and Blurb sizes, covers worked out
photos uploaded: it all stays on your device

features.title: A first draft for you
features.text: Import a folder and it lays out the whole book, a chapter per day.
details: Picks the best of each burst and skips duplicates
Keeps favourites; panoramas run across a spread

screen.alt: The whole book at a glance: cover, title page, a contents page listing Day 1 to 3 with page numbers, a Day 1 opener with a map pin, then photo spreads

features.title: Ready for the printer
features.text: Covers, spine and bleed are sized from the printer and the page count.
details: Lulu and Blurb presets, or your own numbers
Preflight flags low DPI and text near the trim
Interior and cover PDFs, checked after export

screen.alt: The cover laid flat: back cover with a small sunset photo and the dates, a 6.3 mm spine, and a front cover with a town photo and the title Amalfi, May 2026

features.title: Templates that restyle
features.text: One click sets the type, paper, cover and colour grade for the whole book.
details: A contents page that keeps its page numbers right
Chapter openers and a closing page, added for you
Posters and collages from the same photos

features.title: Share it as a flipbook
features.text: Export one web page that turns like the printed book.
details: Every page cut from the same print PDF

screens.alt: Photobook Studio editing a travel journal: the photo library on the left, a spread of tilted prints on warm paper in the middle, book templates on the right and every spread along the bottom
screens.caption: A sample trip, drafted as a travel journal

facts.worksOn: Any desktop browser, or a Mac
